decision: Use pinned XMage as the first deterministic rules engine instead of starting a Rust port
why: A replacement needs a trustworthy parity oracle; the existing engine already implements the rules and card corpus

decision: Move RandomUtil.setSeed to immediately before game.start after player and card construction
why: Construction consumed nondeterministic identities before the old seed boundary; engine randomness must begin from a controlled point
result: substantive state matched; option ordering still diverged

decision: Assign stable CABT seats and order player-facing choices by those seats
why: XMage player-list iteration is cursor-based and process-local UUID ordering must not define agent action indices

decision: Canonicalize hidden-state player ordering in the engine fingerprint
why: A verifier cannot use XMage's mutable player cursor as evidence of divergence

decision: Repair literal backslash-n source corruption in semantic identity edits
why: Current CI failed at javac before any determinism test could run

decision: Persist semantic action IDs and reject semantic duplicates
why: Replay identity cannot depend on option array order or process-local UUIDs
result: stable IDs added; ambiguous options fail closed

decision: Separate canonical agent state from private verification digest
why: A hidden-state hash is still hidden-derived information and must not enter model input
result: agent observe omits private digest; host verify/checkpoint retain it

decision: Canonicalize runtime UUIDs out of agent observations and results
why: Fresh JVM identities are not game semantics and made otherwise identical outputs unequal
result: runtime IDs mapped to semantic refs or redacted

decision: Require exact repeated agent observations plus combat, targeting, restore and priority branching
why: Subset hashes alone could hide protocol drift
result: native gate expanded; awaiting full pinned-engine run

decision: Register stable identities in the real-engine smoke fixture
why: Stricter action IDs correctly rejected duplicate unregistered Forest choices; production setup already registers deck cards
result: legacy fixture aligned with production identity contract
